notes: Rates with no observations are null; they are not claims of success.
No balance overrides applied; observed baseline only.
Public runtime lot accuracy is unavailable: hidden predictions are excluded by contract 9.3 (issue #41).

Stage pass/street rates use all 200 seeds including unreached stages; missing stage steps/mortgages contribute zero. Month-money quantiles use only observed month-end samples; reached_stage and sample counts are explicit.

Telemetry steps count command_done events including game.new and rejected commands; they are not identical to autoplay loop iterations. Almanac follow rate is a day with at least one offered yi action and no ji action, divided by days offering yi.
Simulation ok means three stages or legitimate game over, not zero rejected commands or universal clear.
The 600-game reference took 12m35.721s, exceeding the 10-minute budget on a four-CPU quota.
G02 assembled settle peak18.691ms also exceeds its10ms budget; independent one-shot settle1.406ms does not erase that peak.
Shared W0 engine/strict-validator assertions still fail; owned93 combined tests pass. CI budget and legacy UI failures are separate known limits.
Slot margins use public tossed faces minus need; auto-heads/auto-pass are not separately exposed in that event, so no binomial accuracy claim is made.
